subject: Re: Delivery of failed emails re. contract
body:
Hi Jack,

Sorry for my delayed reply. The concern regarding the Insurance clause is that we currently do not hold an insurance policy to meet the requirements mentioned in the contract (or even close to that).

Based on our previous experience, there are a few things making it very difficult to get such policy:

  • We are a small company (less than 50 headcount, less than 5M CAD/2.5M £ ARR)
  • The required limits are very high (1M to 5M £)
  • There are cross-border liabilities involved.
  • We are operating in a niche market and risk assessment for the insurance company is not easy.
That's why many flat out reject providing a policy, or if they do, the premium is unreasonably high (25K CAD / 15K £ or more annually).

The simplest solution would be to remove Clause 48. If this is absolutely not an option, then we insist the cost be covered by the client, but I understand this can be difficult to absorb on their end too. If you can think of an alternative, let me know.

Best,
Mohammad
ᐧ
